name: Перекриття й захист
description:
This lesson focusses on another combined defense. We are now going to defend by means of blocking plus protecting. To do that, we need the help of a third piece.

Don’t worry if you do not get this right away. The examples will help you understand. Take your time to study all three of them. After you have done that, you will be able to do the exercises.

What do you have to do?
Defend against a double attack. Use blocking plus protecting. You will need a third piece to do this.

examples.text:
Black has a double attack on White’s king (check) and bishop.
Can White’s bishop block the attack (red arrow)?
No. It is not safe there. Black will take it.

What can White do?
He calls in the help of another piece: the rook.
He places the rook between the queen and the king.
It blocks the attack on the king. And it protects the rook as well.

A double attack from the black queen on both white knights.
Again, White brings in a helper.
He moves the bishop between the queen and the lower knight.
One knight cannot be taken anymore.
The other is now guarded.

Black’s queen wants to checkmate by taking the pawn.
Plus she is attacking the white knight.
White’s queen will not let this happen!
She moves in between the black queen and pawn.
No checkmate and the knight is safe (X-ray defense!).
Black could take the queen, but that’s okay.
White’s pawn will recapture.
An even trade is often better than losing points.

texts: Try to solve two problems at once.
